description: Infrastructure Resilience and Impact Study for Wildfire-affected Infrastructure in Los Angeles is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Ertugrul Taciroglu, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). In January 2025, two major wildfires devastated the Los Angeles region: the Palisades Fire and the Eaton Fire. Both fires ignited on January 7, 2025, and were fully contained by January 31, 2025. Coverage: Los Angeles, California. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Los Angeles, Wildfire, RAPID Facility, Street View, Uncrewed Aerial Systems (UAS), Wildland-Urban Interface. Published 2025-08-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
